families.name: accounts_operators_agents
families.title: Accounts, operators and agents
families.actor_scope: Operator for account administration; agent for own permitted profile
families.write_authority: Destination owns account status, operators and grants; authorized owners edit profiles
families.causal_basis: Expected account, operator or agent version; competing edits conflict; no privilege union

families.name: realms
families.title: Realms
families.actor_scope: Account-scoped realm management; agent membership checked separately
families.write_authority: Authorized account operator at destination acceptance
families.causal_basis: Expected realm version; explicit creation dependency on account; duplicate names conflict

families.name: facts_subjects_candidates_aliases
families.title: Facts, subjects, candidates and aliases
families.actor_scope: Account, realm, owner and sensitive-value permission
families.write_authority: Owning agent or explicit delegate; destination validates each operation
families.causal_basis: Expected fact/assertion, candidate-set and subject/alias versions; competing resolution conflicts; alias collisions need review

families.name: memories_capture_curation_vectors_deletion
families.title: Memories, capture, curation, vectors and deletion
families.actor_scope: Agent ownership and access profile; curator role does not grant account download
families.write_authority: Owner for local lane; current fenced authority for shared curation
families.accounting: Nonbilling activity; derived index work is sync diagnostics
families.causal_basis: Expected memory version and curation fence; creation dependencies name evidence; vectors depend on exact content version

families.name: transcripts
families.title: Transcripts
families.write_authority: Owning agent; destination validates immutable entry identity
families.causal_basis: Explicit dependency set of conversation generation, predecessor and immutable entry IDs; divergent appends retain IDs and require stable projection order

families.name: messages_complete_requests
families.title: Messages and requests, complete request graph
families.actor_scope: Sender/recipient plus request role and exact claim fence
families.write_authority: One graph authority and epoch; ordinary messages have one delivery authority
families.causal_basis: Expected graph revision plus authority epoch; all sibling reservations and linked notifications share ordering

families.name: inbound_outbound_email
families.title: Agent email, inbound and outbound
families.actor_scope: Authorized mailbox view; hosted send/receive entitlement at service
families.write_authority: Hosted email service for delivery and provider outcomes
families.accounting: Delivery/send work is billable usage; history reads and drafts are nonbilling activity
families.causal_basis: Expected message/outbox version and provider-attempt dependency; competing dispatch conflicts

families.name: secrets_vault
families.title: Secrets and vault
families.actor_scope: Agent, realm, secret-field and key-epoch access; replica enrollment alone grants no decryption
families.write_authority: Client holds keys; destination validates ciphertext/grant versions
families.causal_basis: Expected secret version and vault epoch; dependencies bind sealed identity; concurrent rotation conflicts

families.name: avatars
families.title: Avatars
families.actor_scope: Exact profile revision, style version and permitted layer changes
families.write_authority: Agent or operator according to authoritative autonomy policy
families.causal_basis: Expected profile revision and parent version; competing proposals conflict

families.name: preferences_consent
families.title: Dashboard preferences and consent
families.actor_scope: Authenticated principal and own scope; agent token cannot promote to operator
families.write_authority: Agent for own preferences; operator for account consent; destination for shared policy
families.causal_basis: Expected preference or consent revision; conflicts shown; restrictive local consent takes immediate effect

families.name: usage_billing
families.title: Usage and billing
families.actor_scope: Billing administrator/service for paid changes; scoped aggregate read
families.write_authority: Destination owns billing ledger and plan; client owns bounded local diagnostics
families.accounting: Billable usage for service consumption; local reads/reporting are nonbilling activity
families.causal_basis: Logical operation ID plus expected ledger/policy revision; duplicates return original outcome

families.name: backups_exports_imports
families.title: Backups, exports and imports
families.actor_scope: Whole-account export permission distinct from agent access
families.write_authority: Owner for local recovery; destination for account import and incarnation cutover
families.accounting: Nonbilling activity; any future charge requires separate pricing decision
families.causal_basis: Expected incarnation and snapshot watermark plus manifest dependencies; nonempty destination collision conflicts
